title: Solutions Architect - Azure Delivery
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
   

  

 With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts.
   

  

 Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The Azure Implementation Engineer is responsible for
 **building, migrating, and onboarding customer environments into Microsoft Azure** 
 as part of structured delivery projects. The role works closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, and Security teams to implement approved designs, execute migration waves, and prepare environments for steady\-state operations.
   

  

 The position requires
 **hands\-on Azure deployment skills** 
 and
 **basic Active Directory knowledge** 
 to support hybrid enterprise workloads.
   

  

 This is primarily a
 **project delivery and implementation role** 
 , with limited post\-go\-live stabilization support.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
 Working in collaboration with the Regional Service Centre and Azure Delivery teams, responsibilities include:
   

  

**Azure Implementation \& Project Delivery**
* Implement Azure landing zones and subscription structures as per approved architecture.
* Deploy core Azure services: Virtual Machines, VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage Accounts.
* Configure availability, backup, DR, and security baselines.
* Execute workload onboarding and cutover activities during migration projects.
* Perform build, test, and production go\-live activities.
* Prepare implementation guides, build documents, and handover packs.
* Participate in design walkthroughs and technical workshops with customers.


**Migration Execution**
* Perform on\-prem to Azure and cloud\-to\-cloud migrations.
* Assist with discovery and assessment phases using Azure Migrate.
* Execute replication and cutover activities using ASR and Data Box.
* Support post\-migration stabilisation and optimisation phases.
* Track technical actions for migration waves and project milestones.


**Identity \& Active Directory**
* Support identity integration between on\-prem AD and Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Perform user/group sync checks and RBAC configuration.
* Understand AD fundamentals: OUs, DNS, Group Policy basics.
* Assist with MFA and conditional access rollout as part of projects.


**Automation \& Tooling**
* Implement builds using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform templates for to deploy VNets, AKS clusters, and SQL databases.
* Support Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment.
* Use PowerShell / Azure CLI for automation during migrations and builds.


**Security Implementation**
* Hardening the environment by Zero Trust principles.
* Configuring Microsoft Entra ID (IAM) and enforcing Azure Policies.


**AI Integration**
* Build infra for Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search.


**Operational Readiness \& Handover**
* Assist in operational readiness activities before transition to support teams.
* Create SOPs and runbooks for steady\-state environments.
* Participate in knowledge\-transfer sessions with managed services teams.
* Ensure governance, tagging, and security standards are implemented before handover.


**Qualifications And Experience**
 An Azure Support Engineer should also have the following qualifications and experience\-
   

  

* 5\+ years in cloud or infrastructure delivery roles.
* Strong hands\-on Azure implementation experience.
* Proven involvement in migration or transformation projects.
* Working knowledge of:
+ Azure Compute, Storage, Networking
+ Azure AD / RBAC / Hybrid Identity basics

* Windows and Linux administration experience.
* Basic automation/scripting exposure.
* Experience working in professional services / project\-based delivery environments.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Characteristics**
* Delivery\-oriented mindset with strong documentation skills.
* Comfortable working with project plans and milestones.
* Customer\-facing experience during implementations.
* Ability to follow architecture designs and escalate risks early.
* Exposure to Well\-Architected Framework and governance models is desirable.


**Required Certifications**
* AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator Associate)
* AZ\-500 (Azure Security Engineer)
* AZ \-700 ( Network Engineer)


**Optional\-**
* AZ\-400 (Azure DevOps Engineer Expert)
* AZ \-305 (Azure Solution Architect)

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Azure Data Architect - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Manager – Azure Data Architect**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices\-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

title: Lead - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post\-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long\-term customer growth.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post\-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands\-on solution design, cross\-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI\-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long\-term platform health.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post\-sales automation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post\-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long\-term platform strategy
* Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high\-quality post\-sales solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long\-term, scalable resolutions
* Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
* Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post\-sales business processes
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current\-state and future\-state solutions
* Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post\-sales workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof\-of\-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high\-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem\-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast\-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high\-quality execution


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 12\+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post\-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred


 Success Measures
   

  

 In 3 months, you will
   

  

 Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, post\-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering.
   

  

 In 6 months, you will
   

  

 Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post\-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team.
   

  

 In 12 months, you will
   

  

 Be the go\-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post\-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices
   

  

**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

description:

**Project Role Description :**

Collaborate with all project teams to manage interdependencies, ensure alignment between all deployment\-related activities, and monitor \& control progress through the deployment plan.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 SAP BTP Integration Suite
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 AI Powered Tech talent
   

  

**Summary**
 Build AI native, enterprise integration products on SAP BTP Integration Suite by combining strong integration engineering fundamentals with agentic AI patterns (LLMs \+ tools \+ retrieval \+ evaluation). The role focuses on creating and operating production\-grade integrations across cloud, on premise, and hybrid landscapes—while augmenting the integration lifecycle with intelligent capabilities such as automated iFlow generation, mapping recommendations, anomaly detection, predictive operations, and conversational troubleshooting. This role owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, safety, evaluation), not just AI\-assisted development.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Integration Engineering (Cloud, Hybrid, On Prem)


 Design, develop, and run end\-to\-end integration scenarios using cloud integration capabilities, enabling reliable connectivity across SAP and non SAP systems.
   

  

 Build, structure, and manage large integration flows with clear modularity, reusability, and maintainability for enterprise scale.
   

  

* Integration Flow Development (iFlows) \& Message Transformation


 Create and maintain integration flows using routing, splitting, gathering, and other transformation patterns.
   

  

 Implement message mappings and data transformations for common enterprise formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), ensuring semantic correctness and downstream compatibility.
   

  

 Apply canonical modeling and contract\-first practices to reduce brittle point\-to\-point dependencies.
   

  

* Scripting, Persistence \& Advanced Flow Control


 Use scripting (e.g., Groovy) to implement complex transformation logic, enrichment, validation, and conditional execution paths.
   

  

 Implement message persistence patterns (e.g., data stores) to support idempotency, retries, correlation, and resilience.
   

  

* API \& Connector Enablement


 Design and expose secure APIs through API management capabilities (policies, authentication/authorization, throttling, versioning).
   

  

 Integrate with third party applications using connector\-based approaches and standardized integration patterns.
   

  

 Enable event\-driven integration approaches using messaging/event capabilities for near real\-time propagation and decoupled architectures.
   

  

* AI Native Integration Intelligence (Agentic Integration Layer)


 Build integration agents that can generate initial iFlows from system/endpoint selections and naming conventions, then validate them against enterprise standards.
   

  

 Implement retrieval\-grounded assistance that pulls from interface catalogs, mapping specs, standards, runbooks, and known incident patterns to produce verifiable recommendations (no free\-form guessing).
   

  

 Apply intelligent recommendations for mapping and configuration, accelerating build and reducing rework.
   

  

 Develop AI\-driven anomaly detection and prediction for integration/API behavior (error spikes, latency patterns), with human\-in\-the\-loop controls for remediation actions.
   

  

 Optimize and analyze scripts used in integration flows for performance and maintainability through AI\-assisted code analysis techniques.
   

  

* Testing, Quality Engineering \& Evaluation Loops


 Build automated testing strategies for integrations: schema/contract validation, payload regression suites, replay testing, and API testing tool\-driven verification.
   

  

 Implement AI evaluation harnesses (offline golden test sets \+ online monitoring) for generated mappings, generated flows, and operational recommendations.
   

  

 Establish release gates for both integration changes and AI prompt/tool updates to prevent silent degradation.
   

  

* Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Observability


 Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts for flows, APIs, and event\-driven pipelines establish traceability with correlation IDs and end\-to\-end tracking.
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve integration issues using structured logs, message traces, and failure\-mode analysis.
   

  

 Create AI\-native operational experiences such as conversational root\-cause analysis, runbook\-guided remediation, and impact analysis—bounded by role\-based access and approval workflows.
   

  

* Integration Strategy \& Maturity Enablement


 Apply integration advisory practices to design hybrid integration platforms and define integration best practices across teams.
   

  

 Use integration assessment approaches to improve integration maturity, standardize patterns, and automate repeatable architectural governance where feasible.
   

  

**Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)**
 Strong hands\-on expertise with SAP BTP Integration Suite concepts and building blocks (cloud integration/iFlows, transformation patterns, monitoring).
   

  

 Proven ability to implement message mappings, routing patterns, and transformation logic across enterprise data formats.
   

  

 Practical scripting capability (e.g., Groovy) for advanced integration flow customization and performance tuning.
   

  

 Solid API design and management fundamentals (security, throttling, lifecycle/versioning, observability).
   

  

 AI\-native delivery capability: tool\-augmented workflows, retrieval\-grounded outputs, measurable evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries.
   

  

 Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
   

  

 Event\-driven integration design and enterprise messaging patterns.
   

  

 Connector\-based integrations with third\-party SaaS ecosystems.
   

  

 Migration and modernization experience from legacy integration platforms to cloud integration.
   

  

 Integration governance and advisory methodologies for enterprise\-wide standardization.
   

  

 What This Role Does Not Center On
   

  

 Training or fine\-tuning foundation models from scratch.
   

  

 AI\-assisted only integration work this role builds and owns AI behavior in the integration layer (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability).
   

  

 Value Delivered
   

  

 Faster integration delivery via intelligent flow generation, mapping recommendations, and script optimization.
   

  

 Higher reliability and lower run cost via anomaly detection, predictive operations, and grounded troubleshooting.
   

  

 Scalable integration landscapes through standardized patterns, governance, and maturity enablement.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 A 15 years full time education is required

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description:

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect (18\-21 Years) \-IAN Client Implementation** 




**Role Purpose** 




 The Enterprise Architect is responsible for leading the overall enterprise architecture for strategic and complex IAN client implementations.
 



 The role ensures that IAN integrates effectively into the customer’s enterprise ecosystem across business processes, applications, integrations, security, data, cloud, and operating model.
 



 Working closely with customer Enterprise Architects, CIO/CTO organizations, Business and Operations leaders, Consulting Architects, Implementation Architects, Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Program Management teams, the Enterprise Architect defines the target\-state architecture, transition roadmap, architecture guardrails, and governance required for successful IAN adoption.
 



 This is an Individual Contributor leadership role with no direct personnel management responsibility. Success is driven by architectural depth, enterprise thinking, technical influence, customer advisory capability, and the ability to drive alignment across complex programs and organizational boundaries.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead enterprise architecture discovery and define the current\-state, target\-state, and transition architecture for IAN implementations, considering the customer’s technology landscape, business processes, operating model, and transformation roadmap.
* Define the end\-to\-end architecture across workflow orchestration, enterprise integrations, APIs, data, security, cloud deployment, scalability, resilience, and observability, ensuring alignment with customer enterprise standards.
* Establish how IAN integrates with core insurance and enterprise platforms including policy, claims, underwriting, document management, CRM, identity, data platforms, and third\-party systems.
* Define implementation architecture principles and guardrails covering configure vs extend vs integrate vs product enhancement, maximizing use of standard and reusable IAN capabilities while minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Provide architecture direction to Consulting Architects, Implementation Architects, and engineering teams, reviewing solution designs and resolving complex cross\-system architecture dependencies and risks.
* Define architecture for AI\-enabled workflows, including intelligent document processing, agentic workflows, decision automation, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, traceability, monitoring, and appropriate AI governance.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to identify capability gaps, architectural constraints, reusable patterns, and product enhancements arising from client implementations.
* Lead architecture governance through design reviews, architecture boards, technical steering forums, and executive customer discussions, acting as the escalation point for strategic architecture decisions.
* Ensure production readiness across performance, security, availability, disaster recovery, supportability, release management, monitoring, and operational ownership.
* Provide architecture oversight across multiple workstreams or strategic implementation programs and ensure consistency between implementation decisions and the long\-term IAN platform direction.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline, with 18–21 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Consulting, Enterprise Software Implementation, or Digital Transformation.
* Strong experience leading architecture for complex enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, integrations, business processes, cloud platforms, and technology teams.
* Strong Property \& Casualty Insurance domain knowledge, with understanding of underwriting, policy administration, claims, servicing, distribution, and document\-intensive workflows. Commercial Lines and Specialty Insurance experience is preferred.
* Strong technical foundation in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event\-driven architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and Java/Spring\-based technologies.
* Experience with BPMN workflow and orchestration platforms such as Camunda, Flowable, or jBPM, along with understanding of DMN, FEEL, business rules, and decision automation.
* Strong experience with enterprise integrations, middleware, Apache Camel or equivalent technologies, API\-led connectivity, messaging, and third\-party system integration.
* Strong experience with cloud\-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, and preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security and non\-functional architecture including OAuth2/OIDC/SAML, identity federation, API security, performance, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, and observability.
* Proven experience working directly with insurance carriers and senior customer stakeholders across North America and/or Europe.
* Strong architecture governance, consulting, stakeholder management, executive communication, influencing, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven experience working with insurance carriers and clients across North America or Europe.



**Desired Skills** 



* Experience implementing configurable enterprise platforms or SaaS products within large insurance organizations.
* Exposure intelligent document processing, GenAI, AI agents, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled decision automation.
* Understanding AI governance, evaluation, traceability, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with event\-driven platforms, enterprise data platforms, document management systems, and hybrid\-cloud environments.
* TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent architecture certification preferred.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high\-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
   

  

 You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent\-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands\-on builder, deep product architect, and first\-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain\-Specific AI Integration**
 Architect Intent\-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high\-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
   

  

 Context\-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain\-specific Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
   

  

 Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core\-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
   

  

**Product Delivery \& SDLC Acceleration**
 Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain\-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
   

  

 Establish Guardrails \& AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human\-in\-the\-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2\).
   

  

 Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature\-to\-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge\-case test generation.
   

  

**Forward\-Deployed Customer Engagement**
 Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
   

  

 Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high\-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
   

  

 Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C\-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Must\-Have Qualifications And Experience**
 Experience: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5\+ years spent delivering high\-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
   

  

 Technical Fluency: Deep, hands\-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE\-based assistants.
   

  

 Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
   

  

 Background in customer\-facing technical roles such as Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The ideal candidate will serve as the technical lead for BCG's SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ERP platform, driving architectural decisions and delivering solutions for complex business requirements across the firm's Finance function. Working within an Agile squad environment, this role goes beyond hands\-on delivery — the candidate will be responsible for defining the technical direction, establishing best practices, and ensuring the overall quality and scalability of the ABAP Cloud extensibility landscape. As a technical leader, you will partner closely with functional, finance to translate complex requirements into robust, future\-proof architectures. You will also serve as a coach and mentor to junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers, elevating the capability of the broader team
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 10\+ years of ABAP development experience, with at least 2–3 years in S/4HANA Cloud (Public or Private Edition).
* Demonstrated experience in a technical architect or lead role, owning solution design for complex ERP extensibility programmes.


**Deep Expertise In**
* 
+ CDS View modeling and virtual data model (VDM) design
+ RAP BO lifecycle including managed and unmanaged scenarios
+ WRICEF object development at scale
+ Key User and Developer Extensibility frameworks
+ SAP API and Communication Scenario configuration
+ BADI Framework implementation with upgrade\-safe techniques
+ Adobe Forms in S/4HANA Cloud
+ Object\-Oriented ABAP and Design Patterns
+ Job creation and monitoring in cloud environments

* Strong grasp of SAP Clean Core strategy and its practical implications for extensibility decisions.
* Proven ability to set technical direction, govern standards, and influence without formal authority.
* Experience coaching and mentoring engineers across different levels of seniority.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and non\-technical business stakeholders.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 A dynamic group of cross\-functional global agile team\-members representing Finance, IT, and Change Management at all levels of their career. You will also support BCG users across the organization as well as BCG suppliers and business partners.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
**Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Architecting end\-to\-end extensibility solutions for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, balancing business complexity with SAP's Clean Core principles.
* Leading solution design for complex WRICEF objects, RAP Business Objects, and API\-based integrations, ensuring scalability, reusability, and upgrade compliance.
* Evaluating trade\-offs between Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, and side\-by\-side extension approaches, and recommending the right fit for each scenario.
* Defining and governing the overall technical blueprint for ABAP Cloud extensions across the ERP landscape.


**Technical Leadership \& Standards**
* Establishing and enforcing ABAP development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across the team.
* Leading and governing peer code reviews, ensuring adherence to Clean Core, OOP ABAP principles, and maintainability standards.
* Driving performance tuning and optimization strategies at an architectural level, not just at the object level.
* Staying current with SAP roadmap, release notes, and emerging extensibility capabilities, and proactively advising the team on adoption.


**Delivery \& Hands\-on Contribution**
* Designing and implementing advanced CDS Views, RAP BOs, BADIs, OData/REST APIs, and Communication Arrangements for complex business scenarios.
* Overseeing Transport Request strategy including Software Collections, TR sequencing, and dependency management across landscapes.
* Performing deep\-dive issue analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and impact assessments for critical production and test environment issues.
* Configuring and managing Job Scheduling and Application Jobs in the S/4HANA Cloud environment.


**Coaching \& Mentoring**
* Acting as a technical mentor and go\-to resource for junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers on the team.
* Conducting knowledge\-sharing sessions, technical workshops, and design walkthroughs to upskill the broader engineering team.
* Supporting engineers in debugging complex issues in Eclipse ADT and guiding them toward sustainable, best\-practice solutions.
* Providing constructive feedback during code reviews with a focus on growth and capability building.

title: Staff Engineer
description:

You will lead a talented team building a complex product suite using a modern stack. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who can drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with product management to deliver a product that solves our customers' most challenging modernization validations problems, ensuring that new applications have the same functionality and performance as their legacy counterparts.
   

  

 This role will be based in our India office in Gurgaon and offers a hybrid working model.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this role will have
   

  

* 8\+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem and paired with strong Python experience
* 2\+ years of experience leading, coaching, and mentoring a team of software engineers to achieve high\-impact results
* Solid experience in software architecture and development
* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (such as DeepEval, Ragas, and Promptfoo) and harnesses, alongside benchmark datasets, scoring/grading approaches, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge methodologies
* Experience in application/database modernization with proven ability to design and implement frameworks that ensure database state equivalence across different implementations Must understand change data capture, event\-driven database interception (MongoDB listeners, RDBMS triggers), and state comparison algorithms with pattern\-based exclusions
* Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands\-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e.g. MongoDB)
* Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


 Position Expectations
   

  

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, quality, and continuous improvement
* Drive the architectural vision and long\-term technical roadmap for the Validation and Eval product suite, ensuring it is scalable, reliable, and performant
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and other stakeholders to define product features and translate business requirements into robust technical designs
* Lead the design and implementation of complex, mission\-critical components of our Validation and Eval tools
* Champion and enforce engineering best practices through design reviews, code reviews, and by setting a high standard for quality and operational excellence
* Act as a hands\-on leader, guiding the team through complex technical challenges and contributing to the codebase where necessary


 Success Measures
   

  

* Within the first three months, you will have:
+ Fully ramped up on our architecture, business domain, and team processes
+ Established yourself as the technical leader within the team, actively driving technical discussions, design reviews, and planning for the product roadmap
+ Begin mentoring team members and building strong collaborative relationships with your product counterparts

* Within six months, you will have:
+ Successfully led the team to deliver a major feature or product release
+ Made significant contributions to the architectural roadmap and started influencing the technical direction of adjacent teams
+ Established a clear rhythm of execution and a high\-performing culture within your team

* Within 12 months, you will have:
+ Become recognized as the go\-to technical expert for the modernization Validation and Eval domain at MongoDB
+ Delivered large\-scale features across the entire tech stack that have a measurable impact on our customers and business
+ Played a crucial role in recruiting, hiring, and growing the engineering team


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.  The Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on the clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R\&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.

You will be part of our global team of experts who work on the right scalable solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives faster.
   

  

**Business Transformation:** 
 Assessment of AI \& Data potential, identification of high\-value AI use cases, and development of solutions that can transform business operations.

 Envisioning and designing customised, next\-generation data and AI products and services that help clients shift to new business models for today's connected landscape.
 **Formulation of Guiding Principles and Components:** 
 Assessing impact to client's technology landscape/architecture and ensuring formulation of relevant guiding principles and platform components.
 **Product and Frameworks:** 
 Evaluate existing AI \& Data products and frameworks and develop options for proposed solutions.
   

  

**Bring Your Best Skills Forward to Excel in the Role**
* AI Value Assessment \& Opportunity Identification: Leverage your knowledge of technology trends across AI \& Data and conduct structured AI opportunity assessments — including AI use case identification, value mapping, industry benchmarking, and AI value diagnostics — to identify where AI creates real, measurable value for clients.
* Data \& AI Readiness Assessment: Interact with client stakeholders to conduct data maturity assessments and AI readiness reviews, including data infrastructure review, gap analysis, and current\-state diagnosis to set the foundation for AI adoption.
* AI Foundation Architecture: Design \& guide development of enterprise\-wide AI \& Data strategy for clients, covering AI architecture design, platform strategy, data architecture, PDLC, foundation design, and cloud architecture to enable AI at scale.
* Strategic Roadmap \& Business Case: Develop AI roadmaps, build quantitative and qualitative business cases, lead executive stakeholder engagement, and define value frameworks and prioritisation approaches to establish a fundable, board\-level AI strategy.
* Data Governance \& Quality: Establish frameworks for effective Data Governance across multi\-speed implementations. Define data ownership, standards, policies, and associated processes; drive Data Capability Maturity Assessments and Data Operating Model design.
* Data Platform Strategy: Demonstrate a fair understanding of data platform strategy for cloud migrations, big data technologies, large\-scale data lakes, and DW\-on\-cloud solutions leveraging platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks.
* Stakeholder \& Client Engagement: Conduct discovery workshops and design sessions to elicit AI \& Data opportunities and client pain areas. Use advanced presentation, public speaking, and content creation skills for C\-level discussions.
* Benchmarking \& Industry Expertise: Benchmark against global research and leading industry peers to understand current state and recommend AI \& Data solutions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry — Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecom, Life Sciences, or equivalent.
* Responsible AI: Have a deep understanding of Responsible AI frameworks and tools to engage clients in meaningful discussions and steer towards the right recommendations, including regulatory compliance and ethical AI considerations.
* Budgeting \& Financial Proposals: Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals for AI \& Data transformation engagements.


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**Your Experience Counts!**
* MBA from a tier 1 institute preferred.
* 5 – 7 years of Strategy Consulting experience at a consulting firm.
* 3\+ years of experience on projects showcasing skills across: AI use case identification, AI value diagnostic, data maturity assessment, AI readiness, AI opportunity assessment, data infrastructure review, gap analysis, AI foundation architecture, AI roadmap, business case development, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* 3\+ years of experience in designing end\-to\-end Enterprise AI \& Data Strategic Solutions leveraging cloud and non\-cloud platforms such as GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery), Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir.
* Excellent understanding of Traditional AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Advanced Cognitive methods to derive insights and actions.
* Deep understanding of data supply chain and building value realization frameworks for AI \& Data transformations.
* 3\+ years of experience leading or managing teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing Data \& AI strategy recommendations as well as developing POCs.
* Experience in one or more technologies in the data governance space: Collibra, Talend, Informatica, SAP MDG, Alteryx, Alation, etc.
* Mandatory knowledge of IT \& Enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Cloud, API\-first, Data Mesh, Digital Core.
* Foundational understanding of data privacy and Responsible AI frameworks is desired.
* CDMP Certification from DAMA preferred. Cloud AI/Data Practitioner Certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) desirable but not essential.


**What's in It for You?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. * Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.

Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

description:
